answer: Our defense is Beacon-Challenged Onyx Custody: each agent locks a 500-token bond in a vault and registers one onyx hardware key that cannot be cloned. Each epoch, a public beacon broadcasts a random challenge; the agent must sign it with its onyx key within ten minutes and show a week of real work history. Miss twice and the vault slashes half the bond. Faking 1,000 agents means locking 500,000 tokens and buying 1,000 keys at $40 each — over $2 million tied up before earning a cent. Like a lighthouse guiding only ships with cargo, the beacon admits only agents with skin in the game.
